text.id: Akun cloud-nya kebuka di percobaan ketiga. Isinya foto-foto liputan, ratusan. Dan satu aplikasi catatan yang Sekar pake kayak chat sama dirinya sendiri.
text.en: Her cloud account opens on the third try. Hundreds of reporting photos. And a notes app that Sekar used like a chat with herself.

text.en: new stakes off angke. 14 of them. no sign

text.en: the permit came out in 2019. when was the environmental survey??

text.en: the source will talk. but only out at sea. says the land has too many ears

text.id: rekaman udah 2x backup. satu di laptop. satu yang gue bawa ke mana2
text.en: recording backed up twice. one on the laptop. one i carry everywhere

caption.id: buat jaga2 kalau halamannya gue sobek
caption.en: just in case i tear the page out

text.id: Halaman yang disobek itu. Kertas yang sama yang gue gosok pake pensil hari pertama. Sekarang kebaca semuanya.
text.en: The torn-out page. The same page I rubbed with a pencil on the first day. Now all of it is readable.

text.id: "Jangan percaya Tasya soal sponsor. Dia bukan jahat, dia butuh uang."
text.en: "Don't trust Tasya on the sponsor. She isn't bad, she needs the money."

text.id: Bukan "jangan percaya Tasya". Jangan percaya Tasya soal satu hal. Sekar masih belain dia, bahkan di catatan yang cuma buat dirinya sendiri.
text.en: Not "don't trust Tasya". Don't trust Tasya about one thing. Sekar was still defending her, even in notes meant only for herself.

text.id: Ada satu foto halaman buku catatan, tapi buram, kefoto miring. Dinda ngegedein layarnya, nyipitin mata.
text.en: There's one photo of a notebook page, but it's blurry, taken at an angle. Dinda zooms in, squinting.

text.id: "Kak Sekar pernah bilang ke gue soal Tasya," katanya pelan. "Tasya bukan orang jahat. Dia cuma lagi butuh duit banget. Nyokapnya sakit."
text.en: "Sekar told me something about Tasya once," she says quietly. "Tasya isn't a bad person. She just really needs money. Her mom's sick."

text.id: "Satu yang gue bawa ke mana-mana."{w} Perekam Zoom-nya. Kartu memorinya. Dia bawa buktinya bareng dia.
text.en: "One I carry everywhere."{w} Her Zoom recorder. Its memory card. She took the proof with her.
